chunks.title: About PopupGenix
chunks.text: PopupGenix is a founder-led software studio in Albuquerque, NM (founded 2024). It builds AI sales agents, custom software, automation, websites, mobile apps, CRM and SaaS tools, and cloud/DevOps for growing businesses worldwide.

chunks.title: Pricing
chunks.text: Starter is $500 per month: Ongoing development and automation hours for small teams, with weekly progress updates and email support. Project work is a custom quote: A defined build such as an AI agent, portal or website. Discovery and a written scope come first, then design, build and launch, with 30-day post-launch support. The client owns the code. Enterprise is custom: Larger platforms, multi-tenant products and long-term partnerships, with a dedicated team and roadmap. No other price is published.

chunks.title: Contact
chunks.text: Email hello@popupgenix.com, phone +1 479 689 1012, or the contact form at /contact. Replies come within one business day.

chunks.title: AI Sales Agents
chunks.text: AI Sales Agents: AI sales agents answer every enquiry instantly on your website, WhatsApp or phone, qualify leads against your own criteria, book meetings into your calendar, and log summaries in your CRM. A human takes over for anything sensitive. Built for service businesses, agencies, clinics, real estate teams and B2B companies that lose leads to slow follow-up. A focused website chat agent can usually be live within a few weeks; voice and multi-channel agents are scoped after a discovery call.

chunks.title: Custom Software
chunks.text: Custom Software: Custom web platforms, internal tools, dashboards and SaaS products designed around how the business works. Discovery and a written scope come before any build. Includes database design, API, admin dashboard, authentication and roles, automated tests and documented deployment. The client owns the source code and the infrastructure accounts. Existing codebases can be audited and extended.

chunks.title: AI and Automation
chunks.text: AI and Automation: Workflow automation and practical AI features for lead handling, document processing, reporting and follow-ups. A process audit comes first. AI is only used where it measurably helps; if a plain rule or script does the job, that is used instead. Includes error handling, monitoring, evaluation on real data and a support window after go-live. Data privacy is designed in, and self-hosted models can be used where required.

chunks.title: Web Development
chunks.text: Web Development: Fast, accessible, search-friendly websites and web apps. Includes a design system, responsive layouts, SEO metadata, sitemap and structured data, CMS or WordPress blog integration, analytics, and deployment. Redesigns keep what already ranks and converts. Content can be edited by the client's own team.

chunks.title: Mobile Apps
chunks.text: Mobile Apps: Cross-platform iOS and Android apps from one codebase using React Native and Expo, with a secure backend, push notifications, analytics and App Store and Google Play submission support. Native is only recommended when the product genuinely needs it. Flutter and fully native Swift or Kotlin apps are not listed services.

chunks.title: CRM and SaaS Tools
chunks.text: CRM and SaaS Tools: CRMs, client portals, lead-management systems and subscription products with multi-tenant architecture, role-based access, billing and plan management, email notifications and activity logs. Can integrate with the CRM a client already uses, or replace it.

chunks.title: Cloud and DevOps
chunks.text: Cloud and DevOps: CI/CD pipelines, Docker and environment configuration, monitoring and alerting, backup and recovery plans, and cost-aware cloud infrastructure on Cloudflare, AWS or GCP. Existing setups can be taken over after an audit that fixes the highest-risk issues first.

chunks.title: Process
chunks.text: Five steps. Discover: a short call to understand goals and where time or leads are lost, then a written scope and a fixed or phased quote. Design: flows, data and interface mapped and signed off before building. Build: small visible increments with automated tests, code review and weekly updates. Launch: deployment, monitoring and a handover session. Support: a support window after launch and optional monthly retainers. Clients own the code.

chunks.title: FluxPOS
chunks.text: FluxPOS is a built multi-tenant point-of-sale and operations platform for restaurants and multi-vendor food markets: orders, tables and tabs with live updates, menus with recipes linked to ingredients, inventory and waste tracking, vendor settlement with commissions and payouts, role-based access, audit log and subscription billing. Built with Next.js, TypeScript, Prisma and Tailwind CSS. Status: Built.

chunks.title: AutoLead Manager
chunks.text: AutoLead Manager (also called HOM) is a live sales growth engine: lead discovery, email campaigns, pipeline and client tracking in one dashboard. It is the foundation for the AI sales agent workflow. Status: Live. Link: https://autolead-manager.pages.dev/

chunks.title: Clarify AI
chunks.text: Clarify AI is a live AI-powered data analysis platform that turns complex datasets into clear, actionable insights for decision makers. Status: Live. Link: https://www.clarify.ai/

chunks.title: Klevere AI
chunks.text: Klevere AI is a live business intelligence SaaS platform with automated reporting and predictive analytics on company data. Status: Live. Link: https://www.klevere.ai/

chunks.title: BlackGPT
chunks.text: BlackGPT is a live conversational AI chatbot with a specialised knowledge base and natural-language understanding for focused answers. Status: Live. Link: https://blackgpt.us/

chunks.title: Inno AI
chunks.text: Inno AI is still in development and not yet public. It is an ingredient compliance checker for EU and US food additive rules. It is not a finished client project. Status: In development.

chunks.title: PopupGenix AI Sales Employee
chunks.text: The PopupGenix AI Sales Employee is PopupGenix's own multi-tenant platform where each business configures its own AI voice sales agent. It is in development (architecture and foundations phase), not yet released. Status: In development.

chunks.title: FAQ
chunks.text: Clients own the source code and the infrastructure accounts it runs on.

chunks.title: FAQ
chunks.text: Existing codebases and setups can be audited, stabilised and extended. The audit comes first and the highest-risk issues are fixed first.

chunks.title: FAQ
chunks.text: Systems are designed around the client's data policies. Only the minimum data is sent to third-party models, role-based access and audit logs are standard in custom platforms, and self-hosted models can be used where required. Specific compliance requirements are reviewed on the discovery call.

chunks.title: FAQ
chunks.text: AI agents are grounded in the client's own documents, tested against real enquiries before launch, and given clear handover rules so a human takes over for sensitive or complex requests. Where a plain rule is more reliable than AI, a rule is used.

chunks.title: FAQ
chunks.text: Common CRMs, calendars, email and WhatsApp are standard integrations. If a tool has an API, it can usually be connected. Specific tools are confirmed on the discovery call.

chunks.title: FAQ
chunks.text: Timelines are set in the written scope after a discovery call, because they depend on the project. A focused website chat agent can usually be live within a few weeks. The assistant cannot promise a delivery date; a human confirms timelines.

chunks.title: FAQ
chunks.text: PopupGenix is based in Albuquerque, NM, USA, and works with clients worldwide.

chunks.title: FAQ
chunks.text: PopupGenix is founder-led. Abdullah Al Fahad is the founder and CEO. Work is done by a small team under his direction.

chunks.title: FAQ
chunks.text: Project work includes 30-day post-launch support. Optional monthly retainers (such as the $500 per month Starter plan) cover ongoing improvements and maintenance.

chunks.title: FAQ
chunks.text: AI is not always the answer. If a simple rule or script does the job reliably, PopupGenix says so and uses that. AI is added where it measurably helps.

chunks.title: Guidance
chunks.text: See the data and privacy answer. Offer a call to review specific requirements.

chunks.title: Guidance
chunks.text: See the mistakes answer. Agents are grounded in the client's documents and hand off to a human for anything sensitive.

chunks.title: Guidance
chunks.text: PopupGenix does the setup end to end (design, build, launch, handover), so the client's team does not need technical expertise.

chunks.title: Guidance
chunks.text: Frame value as not losing leads to slow follow-up and removing manual work. State the $500 per month Starter plan and that project work is a custom quote after a short call. Do not invent savings figures.
